description: Global TreeFrogUI content profile — one schema for all handhelds (R36SX/SF3000/SF3500/GB350 etc). Device-specific logic limited to SD detection/markers and optional capability checks.

artwork.notes: Do NOT implement another scraper. App may provide open action and verify .res artwork, but must not build second artwork backend.

archive_policy.inspection: inspect entries before copy — see archive_policy.json for full Phase 2A policy
archive_policy.otherwise: extract_and_classify or grouped per per-system mode; manual_review if unresolved

nested_archives.notes: Handle nested archives only within bounded explicit policy; depth>max_depth => manual_review (bomb guard)

archive_policy.abstraction: ArchiveHandler trait (ZipHandler implemented, SevenZ/Rar stubs return unsupported_archive) — planner does not need rewrite when 7z/RAR tooling becomes available

duplicate_handling.definition: same content, not merely same filename
algorithm: compare cheap metadata first (size, mtime if available)
use SHA-256 when exact identity decision required
classify: same path + same hash -> unchanged; different path + same hash -> duplicate content default skip; same path + different hash -> conflict; new path + new hash -> copy

sync_policy.example_plan: 2,331 unchanged, 34 new, 12 changed, 7 duplicate content, 3 conflicts, 0 deletions
